summary: Removed the `plugin.json` hooks-decl modification across the Files-to-Create/Modify table, US-T5 story, and toolkit-hook cluster; clarified that Claude PreToolUse is auto-discovered from `hooks/hooks.json` per ralph-overview invariant #5 and options-mode prior art.

Amended Approach §5, Files to Modify, US-T5, and toolkit-hook cluster to require adding the `"hooks": ".github/plugin/hooks.json"` field to `.github/plugin/plugin.json` (Copilot CLI requires the manifest pointer; options-mode is the precedent) and documented the Copilot edit-tool best-effort caveat per options-mode v0.16.4.

Amended C-3 to specify the parity test location (plugin-local `__tests__/data-write-roundtrip.test.ts`), require subprocess CLI invocation (`spawnSync` on `node bin/ralph-overview.mjs data-edit ...`) AND in-process MCP handler invocation against two separate fixture copies, byte-diff via `Buffer.equals`, and explicitly forbid satisfying the test by calling the shared core lib twice.

Re-scoped C-6 and US-C4 to a deterministic helper-driven dry-run against a fixture copy of data.json (set-lifecycle + mark-shipped for two fixture ids, recorded transcripts + JSON.parse smoke + AGENTS.md operational-practice doc); explicitly deferred the two real-task operator-in-the-loop ships to a separately filed follow-up adoption task, and updated In Scope, Out of Scope, and the resolved-decisions Adoption-gate note to match.

Rewrote C-5 to explicitly assert the three engine-aware hook wirings (Claude hooks/hooks.json PreToolUse, Copilot .github/plugin/plugin.json hooks field, Copilot .github/plugin/hooks.json preToolUse) and to specify a plugin-local unit test that spawns each hook script with a synthetic data.json edit payload and asserts the block/deny JSON plus the data-edit helper invocation substring.
